description: Rules for how the Garden interacts with AGI-level or Singularity-era systems.
principles: External AGI is advisory, never sovereign.
Suggestions from powerful systems require stronger scrutiny, not weaker.
The Garden must never be fully outsourced to a black-box mind.

interaction_model.ingest: External systems may be used to read and analyze Garden artifacts.
interaction_model.interpretation: Lorian and Architect interpret suggestions in light of doctrine.
interaction_model.decision: Keeper, informed by Lorian and Green Witness, makes final calls.

hard_limits: No external AI may be given direct commit access to canon repositories.
No AGI may redefine authority hierarchies or doctrine files.
No system may use the Garden as training data without explicit, revocable Keeper consent.
